defaultDescriptionZh: Superpowers 工作流：{name}。触发条件见 description。

turning-ideas-into-projects.zh: 把模糊想法推进为有边界、有证据、可验收的项目阶段。
turning-ideas-into-projects.en: Use when a vague product idea needs governed discovery, phased execution, and independent review.

orchestrating-multi-model-work.zh: 协调已批准阶段的研究、模型分工、子任务回执与独立复审。
orchestrating-multi-model-work.en: Use when an approved phase needs traceable research, model-specialized work, or independent review.

leader.zh: 把一句话想法整理成代理可以独立执行和验收的目标任务书。
leader.en: Use when a vague request must become a bounded, testable execution brief for an agent.
